description: This Java class 'PaginationParameters' encapsulates pagination settings such as limit, offset, order by, and sort order, and provides methods to generate SQL snippets for pagination queries.

classes.name: PaginationParameters
classes.description: A class that holds pagination parameters and provides SQL query fragment generation methods.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value, defaulting to 200 if null, or null for unlimited (zero or negative).

methods.name: hasOrderBy
methods.description: Checks if the orderBy string is not blank.

methods.name: hasSortOrder
methods.description: Checks if the sortOrder string is not blank.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if the limit is set and greater than zero.

methods.name: hasOffset
methods.description: Checks if the offset is set.

methods.name: orderBySql
methods.description: Generates the SQL 'order by' clause based on orderBy and sortOrder.

methods.name: limitSql
methods.description: Generates the SQL 'limit' and 'offset' clause based on limit and offset.

methods.name: paginationSql
methods.description: Combines orderBySql and limitSql to produce a full pagination SQL fragment.
